I keep a memory buffer with the precomputed words, so the algorithm goes like this: 1) Grab words from the input buffer to hash 2) schedule words from these. 3) Grab the initial digest from a memory buffer 4) feed the scheduled words to the usual rounds. 5) save the digest to later add 6) grab hardcoded scheduled words for the padding block from a memory buffer 7) feed them to the usual rounds. 8) Add the diggest saved in 5 and output. excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
I keep a memory buffer with the precomputed words, so the algorithm goes like this: 
1) Grab words from the input buffer to hash
2) schedule words from these. 
3) Grab the initial digest from a memory buffer
4) feed the scheduled words to the usual rounds. 
5) save the digest to later add
6) grab hardcoded scheduled words for the padding block from a memory buffer
7) feed them to the usual rounds. 
8) Add the diggest saved in 5 and output. 
So the step that is saved in the 6--8 block is what happened in 2), we do not need to compute these scheduled words.
